what: TOP proc-macro blocker (self-build 00:03, 8 proc-macro libs, 122 refusals: proc_macro::bridge::client methods and run_client, MissingFunctionDefinition in a closure). The calls are Result::<_, PanicMessage>::decode and <(ExpnGlobals<Span>, A)>::decode; each needs X: for<'s> Decode<'a, 's, S> from an impl written `impl<S> Decode<'_, '_, S> for X` (PanicMessage, Span). crates/hir-ty/src/lower.rs anonymous_lifetime (592-593): under LifetimeElisionKind::AnonymousCreateParameter, the impl header elision lower_impl_trait (2362) and lower_impl_self_ty use, an elided `'_` is self.types.regions.error, a fallback. rustc (rustc_resolve late.rs, LifetimeRibKind::AnonymousCreateParameter -> create_fresh_lifetime; the impl gets a LifetimeParamKind::Elided early-bound param per elided lifetime) makes each a fresh parameter of the impl. Fix: give the impl one generic lifetime parameter per elided lifetime of its header (hir-def generics of the impl, in source order) and have anonymous_lifetime return the next one under AnonymousCreateParameter in an impl header. Tests (hir-ty-mir src/tests/mir/lower.rs): a_type_relative_call_with_a_placeholder_lowers_in_a_closure, a_type_anchored_call_on_a_bound_parameter_lowers_in_a_closure must pass; a_type_relative_call_lowers_in_a_closure_with_named_impl_lifetimes is the same with the lifetimes named and should pass before the fix (if it fails too, the cause is elsewhere: tell no-fallback-front-mir).
